name: Clock
author: Aidan Timson
description: A compact clock with a calendar, year progress, and adjustable world clocks.

barWidget.description: A compact clock with a calendar, year progress, and adjustable world clocks.

schema.label: Bar format
schema.description: Qt date format for a horizontal bar. 'ww' is replaced with the ISO week number.

schema.label: Vertical bar format
schema.description: Qt date format for a vertical bar. Newlines stack the label.

schema.label: Week starts on
schema.description: Leave unset to follow the system locale. Clicking the calendar's W heading also toggles it.

schema.label: Birth year
schema.description: Set a birth year to show life progress below year progress. 0 hides it.

schema.label: Life expectancy
schema.description: Years used for life progress when a birth year is set.
